title: Create ClassCamCore package and Sendable model value types
description:
## Goal
The ClassCamCore Swift package compiles with no UI/capture-framework import and exports all Sendable model value types.

## Files
- `ClassCamCore/Package.swift`
- `ClassCamCore/Sources/ClassCamCore/Model/Stage.swift`
- `ClassCamCore/Sources/ClassCamCore/Model/ProcessingState.swift`
- `ClassCamCore/Sources/ClassCamCore/Model/CapturedImage.swift`
- `ClassCamCore/Sources/ClassCamCore/Model/AspectRatio.swift`
- `ClassCamCore/Sources/ClassCamCore/Model/WhiteBalanceGains.swift`
- `ClassCamCore/Sources/ClassCamCore/Model/WhitePoint.swift`
- `ClassCamCore/Sources/ClassCamCore/Model/Slide.swift`
- `ClassCamCore/Tests/ClassCamCoreTests/ModelShapeTests.swift`

## Constraints and Decisions
- **Package purity:** ClassCamCore links no UIKit/AVFoundation/SwiftUI; depends only on CoreGraphics value primitives.
- **Sendable value types:** every model type is a struct/enum conforming to Sendable; no classes, no shared mutable state.
- **Stage shape:** `enum Stage { case capture; case processing(ProcessingState); case result(Slide) }`.
- **ProcessingState shape:** `{ let image: CapturedImage; var quad: Quad; var whitePoint: WhitePoint?; var aspect: AspectRatio }`; whitePoint starts nil.
- **CapturedImage is a thin envelope:** deep-copied pixel handle + orientation tag + pixel dims + colour-space tag (IC-001); it does NOT eagerly decode a full-resolution CGImage. The deep-copy is performed by the capture actor (BEAD still-capture); this bead defines the type + Sendable conformance.
- **AspectRatio:** closed enum `{ sixteenNine, fourThree }`.
- **WhiteBalanceGains:** (r,g,b) multipliers, g == 1 convention.
- **Green with zero simulator:** the test target runs on the host toolchain; no test imports a platform-visual framework.

## Note
Quad is introduced by the sibling bead (quad-math); reference it as a type here, implement its logic there.

## Domain Constraints
- **cuda_device:** n/a
- **tensor_dtype_in:** n/a
- **tensor_dtype_out:** n/a
- **read_path:** n/a
- **write_path:** n/a
- **precision_threshold:** n/a

title: Stand up app skeleton: build config, AppModel, ContentView, stub services
description:
## Goal
The ClassCam app target launches with an @Observable AppModel owning a Stage value, a ContentView that switches on stage, and stub capture/imaging actors, compiling strict-concurrency-clean.

## Files
- `ClassCam.xcodeproj` (build settings: Swift 6 language mode, complete strict concurrency, warnings-as-errors; add ClassCamCore dependency)
- `ClassCam/Info.plist` (add NSCameraUsageDescription)
- `ClassCam/App/ClassCamApp.swift`
- `ClassCam/App/AppModel.swift`
- `ClassCam/App/ContentView.swift`
- `ClassCam/Capture/CaptureService.swift` (stub actor)
- `ClassCam/Imaging/ImagingService.swift` (stub actor)

## Constraints and Decisions
- **One state owner:** AppModel (@MainActor @Observable) is the single navigation source of truth via `var stage: Stage`. No per-screen view-model classes, no coordinator, no DI container (ADR-005).
- **Typed transitions:** entering processing requires a CapturedImage; entering result requires a Slide — encode as method parameters so illegal states do not compile (WS-001 BR2-BR3).
- **Retake/Start-Over resets:** returns stage = .capture, dropping any ProcessingState/Slide (WS-001 BR4).
- **Services are actors behind narrow async interfaces, injected as stubs here:** the shell never touches AVFoundation/Core Image directly; IB-003 swaps the real capture actor in with no shell change.
- **Reuse ClassCamCore types:** import Stage/ProcessingState/CapturedImage/Slide/etc.; do not redeclare them.
- **NSCameraUsageDescription present:** required or the OS crashes on first camera access (WS-002 BR4).
- **Strict concurrency from commit one:** turn the build settings on now; do not defer.

title: Capture full-resolution still: delegate deep-copy, colour tag, orientation, preview wiring
description:
## Goal
Tapping the shutter captures a full-resolution still that is deep-copied, colour-space-tagged, and orientation-sealed into a CapturedImage, shown behind a live .resizeAspect preview.

## Files
- `ClassCam/Capture/PhotoCaptureDelegate.swift` (AVCapturePhotoCaptureDelegate bridged to async via withCheckedThrowingContinuation; retained by settings.uniqueID; deep-copies before resuming)
- `ClassCam/Capture/CameraPreview.swift` (UIViewRepresentable over AVCaptureVideoPreviewLayer as layerClass; videoGravity = .resizeAspect; built once in makeUIView)
- `ClassCam/Capture/CaptureService.swift` (add capturePhoto() async throws -> CapturedImage)
- `ClassCam/Capture/CaptureScreen.swift` (wire real preview + zoom control + shutter)

## Constraints and Decisions
- **Delegate -> async:** bridge capturePhoto(with:delegate:) via withCheckedThrowingContinuation; retain the delegate keyed by settings.uniqueID until didFinishProcessingPhoto (WS-002 BR8).
- **R1 deep copy:** in the completion callback, deep-copy the pixel buffer (or take fileDataRepresentation) BEFORE resuming the continuation; never pass a pooled CVPixelBuffer across the actor line (WS-002 BR9 / IC-001).
- **R2 colour tag:** seal a known colour space (sRGB unless deliberately wide) onto the CapturedImage (WS-002 BR10 / IC-001).
- **Orientation:** use AVCaptureConnection.videoRotationAngle (guard isVideoRotationAngleSupported), NOT the deprecated videoOrientation; seal as metadata, do not pre-rotate pixels.
- **Full resolution regardless of zoom:** the returned still is the full active format even when zoomed (IC-001 cross-field guarantee 1).
- **Preview:** UIViewRepresentable over AVCaptureVideoPreviewLayer, videoGravity = .resizeAspect, built once in makeUIView; updateUIView inert (WS-002 BR6).
- **Lifecycle:** observe wasInterrupted/interruptionEnded; stop on disappear/background; restart on return (WS-002 BR11).

title: Build the draggable corner-handle overlay on normalized points
description:
## Goal
Overlay four draggable corner handles on the captured still in the processing screen. Handle positions are computed from the normalized Quad corners via the ClassCamCore Geometry conversions (b1); a per-handle DragGesture updates the grabbed corner. All drag math is @MainActor on normalized points — no pixels are touched on the main thread.

## Files
- `ClassCam/Processing/CornerHandleOverlay.swift`
- `ClassCam/Processing/CornerDragModel.swift`

## Constraints and Decisions
- **Drag stays on main, in normalized space:** a handle drag updates the grabbed corner's normalized point on @MainActor via the b1 conversions; NO pixel conversion runs on main (WS-004 BR7, ADR-005).
- **Validated after every drag:** the updated four corners reconstruct a `Quad` through the WS-001 failable init so ProcessingState.quad is always valid (WS-004 BR7 / WS-001 BR6-BR7).
- **Conversions via Geometry:** handle placement converts normalized Quad corners to view points through ClassCamCore/Geometry (b1) — no inline flips.
- **Ephemeral gesture state is local:** grabbed-corner index and in-flight drag offset are view-local @State, not app state.

- **tensor_dtype_in:** n/a

title: Implement ClassCamCore Geometry coordinate-space conversions with round-trip tests
description:
## Goal
The ClassCamCore Geometry slice gains the pure functions that convert the presentation's four corner points between the three coordinate spaces — Vision normalized-bottom-left, Core Image pixel-bottom-left, and SwiftUI/UIKit view-points-top-left — written ONCE, with round-trips proven lossless corner-for-corner on a known rectangle, running green with zero simulator. This is the ADR-007 "written once, unit-tested before device use" hard gate.

## Files
- `ClassCamCore/Sources/ClassCamCore/Geometry/CoordinateSpaces.swift`
- `ClassCamCore/Tests/ClassCamCoreTests/CoordinateSpaceTests.swift`

## Constraints and Decisions
- **Written once:** every origin flip / unit scale between the three spaces lives ONLY in `CoordinateSpaces.swift`; no call site (detection, overlay, warp) re-derives a flip or scale (ADR-007).
- **Pure functions:** output depends only on inputs (point + image `CGSize` px + view `CGSize` + sealed orientation); no captured state — safe on `@MainActor` and the imaging actor alike.
- **Single Y-flip:** exactly one Y-flip separates a bottom-left space (Vision/Core Image) from top-left (SwiftUI/UIKit); normalized-BL to pixel-BL carries NO flip (both bottom-left), only a scale by pixel dims (WS-003 BR4-BR5).
- **Orientation-honest:** the dimension used as height for the flip is the oriented height from the sealed `CGImagePropertyOrientation` (IC-001), so portrait vs landscape flips against the correct axis (WS-003 BR6).
- **Guard degenerate scale:** a zero image dimension must not divide-by / produce a NaN corner; precondition-guard or require valid CapturedImage dims (WS-003 BR8).
- **Green with zero simulator:** tests run on the host toolchain; no test imports a platform-visual framework. `VNImageRectForNormalizedRect` may be used only if it stays a pure helper; otherwise do the explicit multiply.

## Domain Constraints
- **cuda_device:** n/a
- **tensor_dtype_in:** n/a
- **tensor_dtype_out:** n/a
- **read_path:** n/a

title: Implement Quad ordering and validation with failable init
description:
## Goal
A Quad value can be constructed only from four normalized corners that order to TL->TR->BR->BL and pass validation; degenerate input yields nil.

## Files
- `ClassCamCore/Sources/ClassCamCore/Model/Quad.swift`
- `ClassCamCore/Sources/ClassCamCore/Geometry/QuadOrdering.swift`
- `ClassCamCore/Tests/ClassCamCoreTests/QuadTests.swift`

## Constraints and Decisions
- **Quad is validated-by-construction:** `Quad.init` is failable — it orders arbitrary corners to TL->TR->BR->BL and returns nil for degenerate (zero/near-zero area, coincident corners, self-intersecting edges) or out-of-range (any coordinate outside 0-1) input. There is no way to hold an invalid Quad (WS-001 BR6-BR7).
- **Normalized coordinates:** the four points are normalized CGPoint (0-1); ordering is by geometric position, not input order.
- **Package purity:** logic lives in ClassCamCore; imports no UI/capture framework.
- **Green with zero simulator:** tests run on the host toolchain.

## Domain Constraints

- **tensor_dtype_in:** n/a

title: Implement ImagingService.detectQuad VNDetectRectangles wrapper tuned for a glowing angled screen
description:
## Goal
Replace the stub `ImagingService.detectQuad(in:)` with a real `VNDetectRectanglesRequest` wrapper tuned for a glowing angled screen: run it off-main on the actor, pick the best observation by confidence, convert its corners to a normalized, ordered, validated `Quad` through the ClassCamCore Geometry conversions (b1), and return `Quad?` (nil when nothing clears the bar).

## Files
- `ClassCam/Imaging/ImagingService.swift`
- `ClassCam/Imaging/RectangleDetection.swift`

## Constraints and Decisions
- **Tuned for a glowing angled screen:** generous `quadratureTolerance` (~30-45°), low `minimumConfidence` (~0.3), permissive `minimumAspectRatio` (~0.3) + `minimumSize`, a small `maximumObservations` — a bright TV off-axis is not a crisp square document; tightening any of these means real presentations never detect (WS-004 BR1).
- **Best by confidence:** when several observations return, select the single highest-confidence one to seed the handles (WS-004 BR2).
- **Convert through Geometry:** the observation's normalized-BL corners become the Quad's corners via b1's conversions + the WS-001 failable init; NO inline flip (WS-004 BR3, ADR-007).
- **Degenerate -> no detection:** if `Quad` construction fails on the observation's corners, return nil rather than a bad quad (WS-004 BR4).
- **nil is normal:** no observation clearing the bar returns nil — not a throw, not an error (WS-004 BR5).
- **Off main + cancellable:** detection runs on the `ImagingService` actor and honours `Task.isCancelled` around the request (ADR-005).

- **tensor_dtype_in:** n/a

title: Build CaptureService actor with session on serial queue, permissions, zoom

title: Implement ClassCamCore Output sizing + crop-rect math with unit tests
description:
## Goal
Add the pure `Output` slice to ClassCamCore: `longEdgeScale(for:)` (scale so the long edge is exactly 1920), `outputSize(for aspect:)` (1920x1080 for 16:9, 1920x1440 for 4:3), and `cropRect(for aspect:in scaledExtent:)` (centered rect of the aspect's dimensions in bottom-left pixel origin). Pure functions only; the render (b2/b3) calls them.

## Files
- `ClassCamCore/Sources/ClassCamCore/Output/OutputSizing.swift`
- `ClassCamCore/Sources/ClassCamCore/Output/CropRect.swift`
- `ClassCamCore/Tests/ClassCamCoreTests/OutputSizingTests.swift`
- `ClassCamCore/Tests/ClassCamCoreTests/CropRectTests.swift`

## Constraints and Decisions
- **pure_math:** Output imports no UIKit/AVFoundation/SwiftUI/Core Image; inputs are CGSize/AspectRatio, outputs are CGSize/CGRect/CGFloat.
- **exact_output_sizes:** `outputSize(.sixteenNine) == (1920,1080)`, `outputSize(.fourThree) == (1920,1440)` — exact integers, no rounding drift.
- **long_edge_scale:** `longEdgeScale(for: size) == 1920 / max(size.width, size.height)` — landscape and portrait both hit 1920 on the long edge.
- **centered_crop:** `cropRect` is the aspect's (w,h) centered within the scaled extent, bottom-left origin (Core-Image convention), fully inside the extent.
- **zero_simulator:** tests run on the host toolchain; no test imports a platform-visual framework.

title: Wire seed-from-detection and drag-is-source-of-truth into ProcessingScreen
description:
## Goal
On entry to processing, kick detectQuad (b2) from the view's `.task {}`, seed the overlay quad ONCE from the result (or defaultInsetQuad on nil, b3), and hold the adjustable quad in ProcessingState. Thereafter the user's dragged Quad (b4) is the source of truth — detection is NEVER re-run over the user's edits, and a dragged corner is never snapped back.

## Files
- `ClassCam/Processing/ProcessingScreen.swift`

## Constraints and Decisions
- **Seed once, then hands off:** detectQuad seeds the overlay quad exactly once on entry (or defaultInsetQuad on nil); after that the dragged Quad is authoritative and detection is never re-run over edits — a dragged corner is never snapped back (WS-004 BR8, ADR-007).
- **Fallback seed:** on detectQuad == nil, seed from defaultInsetQuad (b3) — never a dead screen (WS-004 BR6).
- **Cancellable seed:** detectQuad is kicked from the view's `.task {}` and cancelled on disappear; no detached `Task` outlives the view (WS-004 BR9; ADR-005).
- **Adjusted quad lives in existing state:** the seeded/dragged quad is held in ProcessingState.quad (WS-001) — no parallel store.
